1.w: A well-written song by David, when he was in the cave; a prayer. To the Lord I cry out; to the Lord I plead for mercy.

2.w: I pour out my lament before him; I tell him about my troubles.

3.w: Even when my strength leaves me, you watch my footsteps. In the path where I walk they have hidden a trap for me.

4.w: Look to the right and see. No one cares about me. I have nowhere to run; no one is concerned about my life.

5.w: I cry out to you, O Lord; I say, “You are my shelter, my security in the land of the living.”

6.w: Listen to my cry for help, for I am in serious trouble. Rescue me from those who chase me, for they are stronger than I am.

7.w: Free me from prison that I may give thanks to your name. Because of me the godly will assemble, for you will vindicate me.
